name: No reboot when a service crashes
description: HarmonyOS reboots the phone when SceneBoard crashes 4 times in 4 minutes, and init reboots it when a 'critical' service (render_service, foundation, samgr, ...) keeps crashing: it first stops every service and unmounts /data, so with the kernel refusing the reboot the phone is left dead. On a port a missing driver is enough to trigger this. The SceneBoard policy is switched off and the critical flag is cleared for every system and vendor service (system ones are re-declared in /vendor, system.img is not rebuilt): crashed services are simply restarted.
